Make Science Fun for School Students!

Create fun Science puzzles using ice cream sticks!

Join our Popsicle Science Puzzles event and make simple puzzles that help children learn Science through play.

Team Everest will distribute your handmade puzzles to school students from grades 1 to 5.

Note: No prior experience is required. We will provide the materials and guide you throughout the activity.

Sign up now and help a child enjoy learning Science!

You just have to commit 2 hours of your time to this activity.
